description.en: MetaAras (MTA) is a professional-grade multichain DeFi governance and utility token deployed on Ethereum and BNB Smart Chain. The protocol features four staking tiers offering 8%–40% fixed APY, on-chain DAO governance with OpenZeppelin Governor v5 and 48-hour Timelock, and transparent linear vesting contracts for team and investors. All protocol parameters — including staking APY, treasury disbursements, and contract upgrades — are controlled exclusively by MTA token holder governance. MetaAras is open-source under the MIT license with a hard-capped supply of 100,000,000 MTA and no inflationary minting mechanism after initial distribution.
